title: スチーム・スライド：僕らの熱量と、氷の城の残像
author: 一ノ瀬 楓

en.title: Steam Slide: Our Burning Passion and the Afterimage of the Ice Castle
en.premise: In the club room after school, the sound of steam drifts in from the window. I reunite with my best friend, Kaito—a former figure skater once hailed as a genius. Now, he struggles within a skating club on the brink of disbandment, fighting to dominate the ice rink with nothing but "heat." This is a story of a boy who lost his former glory and a "nobody" like me, as we sharpen our rusted blades once more.

zh.title: Steam Slide：我们的热量与冰之城的残像
zh.premise: 放学后的社团活动室，窗外传来阵阵蒸汽声。我与曾经被称为天才的前花样滑冰选手、好友海斗重逢了。如今的他，在濒临废部的滑冰部中，正挣扎着试图用“热量”去支配冰面。这是一个失去往日荣光的他，与平凡如我的我，一同重新磨砺生锈冰刀的故事。
